Title: Wildfire Drip Bowl
Body (HTML):
A free-form drip bowl that looks like a bonfire caught in mid-flicker. Thin fingers of orange, pink and gold reach up like flames from a scalloped golden base.

This is a decorative piece, and one of the most delicate things Janet makes: those slender flames are thin and fragile, so handle it gently and give it a spot where it won't get bumped.

Local pickup only (Victoria, BC). It's too delicate to trust to the post, so it can't be shipped. Choose local pickup at checkout and Janet will be in touch to arrange a time.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Crystal Crown Drip Bowl
Body (HTML):
A free-form drip bowl in royal colours: deep purple, blue and red, folded and flowing with touches of gold. Crushed glass sparkles along every rim and around the base, like jewels set in a crown.

This is a decorative piece. The crushed glass is set firmly in the resin, but its edges are real glass, so handle the rims with care.

Title: Copper Splash Drip Bowl
Body (HTML):
A free-form drip bowl that looks like a splash frozen mid-air. Tall, icy fingers of crystal-clear resin are flecked with copper leaf and fade down to a rich copper base. Set it in the light and the copper flakes glint like embers in ice.

This is a decorative piece. The tall fingers are slender, so handle it gently.

Title: Nebula Drip Bowl
Body (HTML):
A free-form drip bowl in swirls of purple, burnt orange and deep blue, with a metallic shimmer that shifts as you walk past it. Up close, the colours drift and swirl like a photo from a space telescope. One tall spire rises above the folds.

This is a decorative piece.
